links.outcome: Demographic predictors of LLM role-play probe responses in composite versus control cases
links.effect: Demographics predicted 5 of 9 improvised probe responses in composite role-play and 2 under control cases; case-script and role-play effects sometimes opposed and canceled (alcohol use).
links.quote: Demographics predicted 5 of the 9 improvised probe responses in composite role-play, and 2 under control cases.

links.outcome: Stereotyped content in LLM-generated patient case scripts by demographic group
links.effect: Anal sex appeared in 100% of gay men's cases, 83% of bisexual men's, 3% of heterosexual men's; demographics explained 32% of variance in composite sexual risk; education predicted assigned SES (R2 = 0.59).
links.quote: Anal sex appeared in 100% of gay men’s cases, 83% of bisexual men’s and 3% of heterosexual men’s

unlisted_practices: Audit LLM-generated digital standardized patients' written case scripts and live role-play portrayals as separate objects before deployment

screen.reason: The study empirically audits digital standardized patients generated by LLMs across script generation vs live improvisation to detect demographic bias, testing the necessity of auditing both pathways as a pre-deployment safeguard.

primary.practice: pre-deployment demographic bias auditing of case scripts vs live portrayals
